summary: The customer called to inquire about a delayed internet router delivery that was supposed to arrive yesterday. The agent checked the order, apologized for the delay, created an urgent note for the delivery company to contact the customer, and promised delivery for today after 5 PM based on the customer's request. The call ended politely with satisfaction.

evidence.text: لقد قمت الآن بتسجيل ملاحظة عاجلة لشركة الشحن عشان يتم التواصل معك اليوم وتحديد موعد دقيق.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Register an urgent note for the shipping company to contact the customer today to schedule delivery.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Note for the delivery representative to contact the customer after 5 PM and ensure delivery today.
